ticker_news.title: Rivian Stock: The EV Recovery Play to Watch
ticker_news.description: Rivian's stock has surged 67% in 2025, reaching levels not seen since early 2024. The company's future hinges on the R2 SUV launching in 2026 at $45,000, which will compete against Toyota's bZ4X, Tesla's Model Y, and Honda's Prologue. Despite recent gains, Rivian faces challenges with declining R1 sales and a negative gross margin, making the R2 launch critical for long-term recovery.
ticker_news.author: Adé Hennis

SPY.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Jones, Nasdaq Futures Slip On Christmas Eve Despite Strong Q3 GDP Report— UiPath, AST SpaceMobile, Ramaco In Focus (UPDATED)
SPY.description: U.S. stock futures declined slightly on Christmas Eve despite a strong Q3 GDP report showing 4.3% annualized growth. Major indices ended higher on Tuesday, with communication services, IT, and energy stocks leading gains. Several stocks gained attention: UiPath jumped 7% after joining the S&P Midcap 400, Citius Pharmaceuticals rose 8.65% on better-than-expected earnings, Ramaco Resources gained 8% after announcing a $100M buyback, and Multi Ways Holdings surged 62.86% on strong revenue growth.
SPY.author: Rishabh Mishra
